messages:
nora: Heads up — after enabling the new SLO-to-notify translation we started seeing a cluster of low-severity alerts for tenant:atlas that look like noise. Anybody seen a pattern yet?
kevin: yep. appears to be the same underlying signal mapped to multiple derived rules. fanout multiplies and then notify spikes.
ash: quick note: we intentionally tightened a few thresholds for the canary, but this seems worse than expected. Could be combination of tighter buckets + legacy rule duplication.
nora: thinking about mitigations: 1) per-tenant dampening (probabilistic), 2) de-dup stream upstream, 3) unify translated rules during import. Which should be prioritized?
kevin: for short-term we should dampen at notify ingress; de-dupe is medium-effort and should be next. Unify-on-import is longer runway.
ash: agree. design idea: a leaky-bucket dampener per-tenant that consumes a small budget on each notify event, and when budget exhausted we sample at p < 1 until budget refills. Refill rate = tokens/sec, config per-tenant.
kevin: storage: keep token counters in Redis with small ttl, and warm hottest tenants in memory. API change: notify response includes dampener header so callers can surface it. example: `X-Notify-Dampened: true; reason=dedup; rate=0.2`
nora: UI: show a tiny blue "dampened" pill on the alert card with hover text: "Delivery delayed to reduce duplicate noise. click for details". Also expose a timeline entry for when dampening applied/unblocked.
ash: RBAC: we need an immediate bypass for oncall with audit logging. Bypass should be time-limited (e.g., 15m) and require check-in.
kevin: metrics to add: `notify.dampener.applied_total{tenant}`, `notify.dampener.sample_rate{tenant}`, `notify.dampener.unblock_burst{tenant}` and a panel `Dampened Alerts (per-tenant)` in SLO dashboard.
ops-bot: FYI added Grafana alert candidate: when `notify.dampener.unblock_burst` > 50 over 5m for any tenant -> paging ops-sre.
ash: rollout plan: default disabled. Enable for 5% high-volume tenants in staging, then 10% in prod after 48h. Console needs an experiment table and per-tenant toggle (dev mode) so SEs can opt into test.
kevin: code sketch for API (pseudo):
```json
POST /v1/notify
{
  "tenant_id": "atlas",
  "events": [{"rule_id":"r-1","sig":1}],
  "client_meta": {"sdk":"js-1.0"}
}
Response 202
{
  "accepted": 1,
  "dampener": {"applied": true, "policy": "leaky_bucket", "sample_rate": 0.2, "reason": "translated_duplicate"}
}
```
nora: nice. One UX nuance: don't call it "drop" in UI language — call it "de-duplicated" or "dampened" so customers understand we're reducing noise, not hiding incidents.
ash: agree. also include an audit trail entry `notify.dampener.audit` with who toggled bypass and when.
kevin: engineering tasks: add redis schema, ingress middleware, response header, metrics export, console pill + tenant experiment table, bypass endpoint.
devex: checklist added to thread: [API spec, Redis schema, Ingress middleware PR, Metrics + Grafana, Console UX mock, Bypass RBAC, Rollout plan doc].
nora: thanks. can we also add a small simulation harness to estimate how many alerts would be suppressed per tenant given current traffic? helps set token refill rates.
kevin: i'll run a sim on the canary dataset and post numbers. aiming to keep visible incident SLO hits > 99% but suppress duplication.
ash: last point: make dampener reasons enums: `translated_duplicate`, `tenant_burst`, `quota_spill`. machine-readable and user-friendly mapping shown in UI.
nora: good. if no objections i'll file JIRA tickets and assign. pinging for a quick sync 9:30am tomorrow. :+1:
